tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Finds notes in S-Note by words in their title or text, or lists notes under a parent, starred notes or the trash. Use first whenever the user refers to a note you have no id for, or asks what notes they have.

query.description: Words to find in titles and text. Omit to list notes

inside.description: Only notes under this note (title or id)

in_trash.description: Search the trash instead of live notes

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Returns a note's text, sub-notes and settings, or a database's columns. Use to answer questions about a note's contents or before editing it, so you know what is already there.

note.description: Note title as the user said it, or its id from search_notes

offset.description: Character offset to continue a long note from next_offset

tools.name: open_note
tools.description: Shows a note or the trash on screen. Use when the user asks to open, go to or see a note.

note.description: Note title or id, or "trash" to show the trash

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Creates a new text note, optionally with Markdown content, or a new table database, at the top level or under another note, and opens it. Use when the user asks to write, start or make a new note, page, list or database.

content.description: Body as Markdown (headings, lists, - [ ] tasks, tables, code)

inside.description: Parent note (title or id). Omit for the workspace top level

as_database.description: Make it a table database instead of a text note

open.description: Show the new note to the user

tools.name: edit_note
tools.description: Changes a note as a whole: adds Markdown at the start or end of its body, renames it, sets its emoji, stars it, locks it or changes how it displays. Use it to title an untitled note instead of adding a heading. To change one part of a note, use update_block on that block instead; this tool never edits individual blocks.

note.description: Note title as the user said it, or its id from search_notes

content.description: Markdown to write into the body

mode.description: Add content at the end or the start of the body

rewrite_whole_note.description: Erase the whole body and write content instead. Only when the user explicitly asks to rewrite the entire note

tools.name: duplicate_note
tools.description: Copies a text note (its body and settings, not its sub-notes) next to the original. Use when the user asks to copy or duplicate a note.

note.description: Note title as the user said it, or its id from search_notes

tools.name: move_notes
tools.description: Moves one or more notes, with their sub-notes, under another note or to the top level. Use when the user asks to move, file or reorganize notes.

items.description: Note title as the user said it, or its id from search_notes

anyOf.description: Note title as the user said it, or its id from search_notes

inside.description: New parent note (title or id), or null for the workspace top level

tools.name: trash_notes
tools.description: Moves notes and their sub-notes to the trash, where they can be restored, or restores them. Use when the user asks to delete, remove or restore notes.

items.description: Note title as the user said it, or its id from search_notes

restore.description: true takes the notes back out of the trash

tools.name: delete_notes_forever
tools.description: Permanently erases notes that are already in the trash, with their sub-notes and databases. This cannot be undone. Use only when the user explicitly asks to delete forever or empty the trash, after confirming which notes.

items.description: Note title as the user said it, or its id from search_notes

notes.description: Notes already in the trash, by title or id

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Lists a database's rows with their column values, optionally only rows whose columns contain given text. Use to answer questions about a table, tracker or list database, or to find a row before updating it.

where.description: Column name → text the cell must contain, e.g. {"Status":"Done"}

tools.name: update_database_rows
tools.description: Adds new rows to a database or changes values in existing rows, several at once. Use when the user asks to add entries or tasks to a table, or to change a status, date, tag or other column.

row.description: Existing row by name or id. Omit to add a new row

additionalProperties.description: Option name(s), text, number, true/false, a date like "2026-10-20" or "tomorrow", or null to clear

values.description: Column name → value. Use "Name" for the row title

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.description: Lists a note's blocks in order with their address, kind, a text preview and child count, plus counts by kind. Use to see a note's structure, count its blocks, or find the address of a block before reading, editing, moving or deleting it.

note.description: Note title or id. Omit for the note on screen

inside.description: List the children of this block instead of the top level

tools.name: read_block
tools.description: Returns blocks' full text, settings, comments and children. Use when you need more than the list_blocks preview, such as a long paragraph, a table's cells or a block's URL. To read several blocks, pass them all in `blocks` in one call instead of calling once per block; to read a whole note, use read_note.

note.description: Note title or id. Omit for the note on screen

blocks.description: Several blocks to read in one call, e.g. ["0", "2", "3.1"]

items.description: Block address from list_blocks, e.g. "3" or "3.1" for the 2nd child of block 3

tools.name: insert_blocks
tools.description: Adds one or more blocks of any kind the "/" menu offers (text, headings, lists, to-dos, toggles, callouts, code, tables, columns, tabs, images, embeds, databases, charts, sub-pages, equations, mentions…) at a position in a note. Use when the user asks to add content of a specific kind. For plain prose, type "markdown" is simplest.

note.description: Note title or id. Omit for the note on screen

where.description: inside = at the end of a container block such as a callout, toggle or column

block.description: Needed for after, before and inside

position.description: Where in the note. Defaults to the end

type.description: Block kind as in the "/" menu

text.description: Text of the block; note title for page/link-page; name for mentions; LaTeX for equations; Markdown for markdown. In a plain text or heading block, Markdown with headings, lists, tables or several paragraphs is turned into real blocks

items.description: List items ("[x] " prefix = checked), toggle lines, column texts or tab titles

rows.description: Table cells row by row; the first row is the header

tools.name: update_block
tools.description: Changes one block anywhere in a note: its text, list items, table cells or settings, ticks a to-do, changes it into another kind of block (e.g. a paragraph into a callout or a list into to-dos), or adds a comment. Use when the user asks to edit, fix, convert, check off or comment on a specific part of a note.

note.description: Note title or id. Omit for the note on screen

block.description: Block address from list_blocks, e.g. "3" or "3.1" for the 2nd child of block 3

text.description: Text of the block; note title for page/link-page; name for mentions; LaTeX for equations; Markdown for markdown. In a plain text or heading block, Markdown with headings, lists, tables or several paragraphs is turned into real blocks

items.description: List items ("[x] " prefix = checked), toggle lines, column texts or tab titles

rows.description: Table cells row by row; the first row is the header

convert_to.description: Change the block into another kind in place, keeping its content, e.g. "callout", "todo", "h2", "toggle"

checked.description: Tick or untick a to-do item

comment.description: Add a comment to the block

tools.name: move_block
tools.description: Moves a block, with everything inside it, to another place in the same note, including into or out of callouts, toggles and columns. Use when the user asks to reorder or move part of a note.

note.description: Note title or id. Omit for the note on screen

block.description: Block address from list_blocks, e.g. "3" or "3.1" for the 2nd child of block 3

where.description: inside = at the end of a container block such as a callout, toggle or column

block.description: Needed for after, before and inside

position.description: Where in the note. Defaults to the end

tools.name: delete_blocks
tools.description: Removes one or more blocks from a note. Use when the user asks to delete or clear specific parts of a note; to remove a whole note use trash_notes.

note.description: Note title or id. Omit for the note on screen

items.description: Block address from list_blocks, e.g. "3" or "3.1" for the 2nd child of block 3

empty_note.description: Needed to remove every block of the note. Only when the user asked to clear the whole note
